scope: Historical unpacked MPI halo and overlap audit, with preregistration and measured evidence. Native MPI and current scientific acceptance remain unevaluated.

criteria.interpretation: H1/H3 hold iff every NP>1 arm matches NP=1 within 1e-12 relative (nine orders stricter than the owner band: a decomposition change must be exact, only the physics-vs-continuum comparison uses the 15% band). H2 uses the acceptance grid N=128; coarser grids are reported as convergence evidence, never as a pass.
criteria.stability_rule: a run producing a non-finite population, rho outside [0.95, 1.05] or max|u| > 0.1 cs is declared failed and reported, never tuned away
criteria.stopping_rule: every arm runs the step count fixed before the run (600 at N=128); the step count is NOT extended after looking at a KPI. Wall budget 600 s per arm, above which the arm moves to the cluster queue
